status: bounded development diagnostic proposal; not frozen or executed by B
purpose: Partition the stage contrast in the current instrumented protocol and test its D-response interaction with the runtime observer switch.

schedule.assignment: uniform independent permutation within each block; fixed before execution

preserve: pinned raw SHA and collection archive
all native clocks and actual SMID
records.units: native same-thread duration cycles; component ns stays None

statistical_plan.point: median of each declared block contrast separately
statistical_plan.candidate_family_confidence: at least 95 percent conditional on appropriate IID blocks
statistical_plan.zero_inside_interval: zero not excluded; not equivalence or absence of perturbation

interpretation: delta_Q/delta_R and delta_Q_minus_R describe signed stage contrasts under the current observer; they do not recover off-path Q.
delta_D_on_minus_off is a block interaction. A median of interactions is not a difference of separately computed median effects.
A detected D interaction establishes a recorded stage-dependent observer response. Failure to detect it does not establish no Q redistribution.
A positive Q contrast with a negative R contrast suggests examining waiting relocation in the instrumented path; medians do not sum to D.
Use outcomes to choose the next mechanism or disprove a candidate. Do not fit new supply constants from this diagnostic.
stopping: Exactly 64 new processes once. Stop/preserve on identity, device, process, numeric or trace failure. No replacement, filtering, extra samples, or timing-based early success stop.

uninstrumented_model_evidence.required: An explicit model must account for the observer nodes and independently predict the corresponding no-added-observer/progress endpoints on new frozen data. D compatibility alone cannot transfer Q to the uninstrumented path.
uninstrumented_model_evidence.original_progress: Historical progress C1/C16 remain a distinct binary/protocol/development reference; do not pool them into the new off arm or relabel cross-batch compatibility as equivalence.

final_goal_scope: All final predeclared cfg_a/b/c acceptance conditions and old failures remain unchanged; this narrow diagnostic grants no family qualification.
source_note: NIST binomial-CDF confidence-limit inversion is the statistical reference; the 16/8 ranks and bounds here are independently derived integer binomial calculations.
